changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Allocation') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] ( [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ScoreType] [int] NOT NULL, [AssetTypeUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [OverrideName] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [State] [int] NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [IsExternallyCalculated] [bit] NOT NULL, [LowerThreshold] [int] NOT NULL, [UpperThreshold] [int] NOT NULL, [CalculationMethod] [int] NOT NULL ) END GO if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'Allocation' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ID') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] ADD ID INT IDENTITY(1,1) end GO if exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'Allocation' and COLUMN_NAME = 'IsThresholdBased') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricsAllocation_IsThresholdBased]; ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] DROP COLUMN [IsThresholdBased]; end
